name: Cranberry
description: Very tart berry, mostly consumed dried or as juice.

histamine.note: Dried/juiced forms often sweetened and sulfured.

effects.note: A 12-week trial gave older adults freeze-dried cranberry equivalent to about a cup of fresh cranberries a day and found improved short-term and episodic memory alongside increased blood flow to memory-related brain regions — though the same trial found no significant change on attention tests specifically. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
